question: The Indian Government scheme, STARS (Strengthening Teaching-Learning and Results for states) project has signed in agreement with ____________ on 28 January 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**World Bank**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Government scheme, **STARS (Strengthening Teaching-Learning and Results for States)** project, signed an agreement with the **World Bank** on 28 January 2021.
 
• The STARS project aims to improve the quality and governance of school education in six Indian states.
 
• The agreement with the World Bank will provide financial support and technical assistance to enhance educational outcomes.
 
• This project focuses on critical areas such as early childhood education, teacher training, and learning assessment systems.
 
• The STARS project aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, which emphasizes holistic and equitable education for all.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **World Bank** is an international financial institution that provides loans and grants to the governments of low and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects.
 
• The bank's projects aim to reduce poverty by supporting economic development and improving living standards.
 
• India has been a significant recipient of World Bank assistance for various development projects, including education, health, infrastructure, and rural development.
 
• Collaborations with international organizations like the World Bank help India leverage global expertise and resources to address local challenges effectively.
